PullCountCalculatorActionParam.title: PullCountCalculatorAction Param
PullCountCalculatorActionParam.description: Pipeline stages for pull-count: init session, record And-recognizer quantities (box_index → OCR digit), then finish and calculate. item_originium_recharge is the raw 衍质源石 count.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: init: start session. record: run items nodes and store quantities. finish: calculate current / next-pool pulls (session first, IMS fallback).

items.title: Items
items.description: Required for record. Map of catalog / IMS item ID → Pipeline And recognition node name. Keys such as item_diamond, item_originium_recharge, item_ticketgacha_special_single.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: When true, a recognizer miss stores 0 instead of failing. Use for 珍贵物品 vouchers. Default false (currencies must hit).
